items.title: Large Language Models as Nonlinear Dynamical Systems: The Three Clocks of Depth, Training, and Generation
items.raw_text:
arXiv:2611.21983v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Language models are dynamical systems. A transformer is iterated over its layers, over the steps of its training and over the tokens it generates, and on each of these three clocks it shows behavior that nonlinear dynamics has studied for a century: fixed points, bifurcations, synchronization, chaos and noise-driven escape from potential wells. The two communities rarely meet, so this behavior is often rediscovered under new names. We build a bridge between them. To describe, we condense about 200 papers into the Three-Clock Dictionary, which maps fifteen concepts of nonlinear dynamics onto each clock and marks every correspondence as proved, measured or conjectured, and we show each concept in a mechanical system and in a language model side by side. To explain, we derive reduced-order models: the softmax is a Boltzmann distribution, gradient descent an Euler step on a nonlinear spring, a loss spike a ball thrown out of a stiff valley,
items.reason_zh: 把Transformer的层、训练步与生成token视为三个时钟的非线性动力系统，视角新颖且具可迁移认知。
items.summary_zh: 论文提出语言模型本质上是动力系统：Transformer在层数、训练步和生成token三个维度上被迭代，构成“深度、训练、生成”三个时钟。作者指出在这三个时钟上，模型都表现出非线性动力学研究了一个世纪的现象，包括不动点、分岔、同步、混沌以及噪声驱动的势阱逃逸。该视角把训练动力学与推理生成统一到同一理论框架下，为理解模型行为提供新的分析语言。
items.title_zh: 作为非线性动力系统的大语言模型：深度、训练与生成的三个时钟

items.title: SOTA or Luck? The Winner's Curse in LLM Leaderboards
items.raw_text:
arXiv:2611.22227v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Public LLM leaderboards guide model evaluation and adoption, yet the reported performance of top-ranked models can be systematically overstated. This leaderboard winner's curse arises because ranking noisy benchmark scores rewards sampling luck alongside genuine ability. The same selection effect can distort scores throughout the leaderboard, a phenomenon we call the rank-induced bias. We develop an $m$-out-of-$N$ bootstrap to correct for this bias. It assumes a fixed model pool with independent, identically distributed bounded tasks while allowing arbitrary within-task correlation among models. Under exact population tiers separated by positive gaps, we prove that the bootstrap reduces $\Theta(N^{-1/2})$ ranking bias to expected residual bias $o(N^{-1/2})$. items.reason_zh: 揭示 LLM 榜单的“赢家诅咒”：排名靠前部分是采样运气，对依赖榜单做选型与评测的读者是重要提醒。
items.summary_zh: 公开 LLM 排行榜是模型评估与选型的重要依据，但榜首模型的报告成绩可能被系统性高估。论文指出这源于“赢家诅咒”：在噪声基准分数上排名，会把采样运气与真实能力一并奖励，且这种选择效应会扭曲整个榜单各位置的分数。作者分析该现象的统计机制，并讨论其对模型评测、榜单解读与选型决策的影响，提示读者谨慎对待榜单上的微小分差。
items.title_zh: SOTA 还是运气？LLM 排行榜中的赢家诅咒

items.raw_text: 本文结合美团基础技术部在 AI 评审、问题排查和自动化开发中的真实实践，分享 AI 能帮上什么忙、容易在哪些地方犯错，以及哪些地方仍需要人来把关。比「多写代码」更重要的，是让代码和结论经得起验证。

items.title: Sashiko: Lessons from building an agentic code review system for Linux
items.raw_text:
The speed of development in large open-source projects has always been limited by code review, not code generation. Even as coding agents get better at writing code, they do not accelerate development on their own. This is especially true of patches to the Linux kernel. Without a way to build trust in proposed changes, more generated code simply piles up in front of the same small group of human maintainers. Some of those patches are solid changes, just written faster; many others are plausible-looking "AI slop" sent by contributors who do not fully understand the systems they are modifying. And the influx of AI-generated security reports, many of which are duplicates or inaccurate, only adds to maintainers’ load.

Linux runs billions of Android phones, most cloud providers, and nearly every supercomputer. It spans more than 35 million lines of code, and
items.reason_zh: 复盘为Linux内核构建agentic代码审查系统的真实取舍，可迁移经验多。
items.summary_zh: 文章指出大型开源项目的开发速度长期受限于代码审查而非代码生成，即便编码 agent 越来越强，也无法单独加速开发，Linux 内核补丁尤其如此。Google 的 Sashiko 项目分享了构建 agentic 代码审查系统的经验：核心难点在于如何让评审者对机器提出的改建立信，涉及审查流程设计、上下文供给、误报控制与人机协作边界等工程取舍。
items.title_zh: Sashiko：为 Linux 构建 agentic 代码审查系统的经验教训

items.title: Scaling Laws for Vision-Language Fusion
items.raw_text:
arXiv:2611.22351v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) have emerged as central foundation models combining multimodal perception with text comprehension. While VLMs are traditionally built via late fusion by continued pre-training an off-the-shelf language model on multimodal (image-text) data, mixing modalities from the start of pre-training (early fusion) has recently gained traction. However, the fundamental trade-offs between these paradigms remain poorly understood, resulting in expensive and heuristic-driven training recipes. In this paper, we systematically analyze the learning dynamics of these multimodal pre-training processes, showing that validation losses during vision-language fusion can be modeled by separating the base learning trajectory, where different data types contribute at distinct rates, from a distribution shift driven by the competition between modalities. items.title: Lost in a Few Heads: Diagnosing and Repairing Block Selection in Sparse Attention
items.raw_text:
arXiv:2611.21917v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Sparse attention models read a few blocks of keys for every query at a fixed budget and can lose much of their long-context retrieval accuracy at that budget. We ask where this loss is made. Using exact attention mass selection at the shipped budget as an oracle, we show that the selector under-ranks the needle rather than running out of budget. We find attention heads that miss the needle by running a calibration probe that teacher-forces the answer and reads two quantities in every head. The first is the needle attention that the selector forfeits, and the second is the share of the answer's log-probability that fixing the head's selection restores, integrated along the path from the shipped selector to full attention. items.summary_zh: 论文研究稀疏注意力模型在固定预算下每查询只读取少量 key 块，长上下文检索精度会明显下降。作者以精确注意力质量选择作为 oracle，发现瓶颈不在预算不足，而是选择器把关键信息（needle）排得过低。进一步定位到少数注意力头的选块失误，并提出诊断与修复方法，恢复检索精度。

items.title: 纽娲机器人创始人杨睿刚：自动驾驶踩过的数据坑，机器人还会再踩一遍丨物理 AI 50 人
items.raw_text:
做了十多年自动驾驶之后，杨睿刚决定把下一次创业的方向，从高速公路转向居民社区。

在此之前，他曾在美国高校研究三维视觉，后来加入百度研究院，负责机器人与自动驾驶实验室，又担任嬴彻科技CTO，推动自动驾驶重卡前装量产。从研究算法到让几十吨重的卡车真正跑上高速公路，他经历了自动驾驶从技术探索走向商业化的过程。

2024年，杨睿刚开始筹备第二次创业。彼时，人形机器人已经成为具身智能行业最受关注的方向，他也接触过相关创业机会，但最终选择了一个看起来没那么性感的场景：社区末端配送。

他判断，家庭机器人虽然市场空间大，但每个家庭的环境都不一样，泛化难度很高；工厂机器人则必须满足严格的生产节拍和成本要求。相比之下，社区配送既能复用自动驾驶积累的定位、导航和避障技术，又能通过开门、乘电梯、交付包裹等任务，让机器人开始与真实物理环境交互。

这也是杨睿刚创办纽娲科技的起点。他希望先让机器人解决移动和通行问题，再逐步进入更复杂的任务。为此，纽娲提出「具行智能」，围绕世界通行模型（WTM）搭建数据生成、物理仿真和模型训练体系。

从见证自动驾驶卡车在开阔道路行驶，到机器人在楼宇间处理各种复杂任务，杨睿刚一直在挑战无人实现的技术问题，但他却说，真正的机会，恰恰在于有些技术问题还没有被解决。

“难这件事，我们不怕。”

从实验室到量产，重新认识技术的价值

《新智驾物理AI》：您很早就开始研究计算机视觉和三维视觉，当时深度学习还没有兴起。为什么会选择这个方向？有没有坐冷板凳的感觉？

杨睿刚：我最早其实不是做计算机视觉，而是做计算机图形学。

我在清华的时候就在CAD和CG实验室，后来去北卡罗来纳大学教堂山分校读博士，也是因为那里在图形学领域很有名。
